result.summary: The page mostly looks fine, but there is one minor visual issue where a restaurant name is truncated with an ellipsis due to card width constraints, unrelated to the standard carousel edge-clipping exception.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated with an ellipsis, cutting off the full name even though it's not at the very edge of the visible scroll area boundary in a way that's clearly intentional edge-clipping.
issues.suggestion: Ensure card width or font size accommodates full restaurant names, or use a tooltip/wrap to show the complete name.
